lead.claim: For degenerative cervical spine disease, consider acupuncture and exercise over manual therapy.
lead.context: Why this matters: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials investigated various conservative interventions for pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease.

supporting.claim: A digital tool combining exercise and CBT may reduce chronic patellofemoral pain.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A multicenter randomized controlled trial examined a smartphone-based intervention for chronic patellofemoral pain.

supporting.claim: Graft type does not affect revision ACL reconstruction risk in football players.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A nationwide cohort analysis investigated if different graft types were associated with revision ACL reconstruction in football players.

supporting.claim: TA VNS with exercise may improve upper limb function in chronic ischemic stroke patients.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A randomized controlled trial evaluated transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation combined with upper limb exercises in chronic ischemic stroke.

supporting.claim: Low pre-stroke physical activity may predict persistent inactivity after minor stroke.
supporting.context: Why this matters: A secondary analysis explored the link between pre-stroke physical activity and activity levels one year after minor stroke.
